description: Microcopy rules of Loui DS as data, for linters, MCP tools and prompts. Rules marked check=static can be enforced on string literals; check=review needs a human or model judgement.

tone.address: Speak to 'you', usually implied ('Select an order').

characters.reason: No exclamation marks anywhere in UI text.

decorativeEllipsis.reason: An ellipsis is only for menu items that open something that needs more input ('Move to…'). Never in buttons, toasts or loading text.

phrases.reason: Name the destination or the action instead.
Say how to fix the problem.
Redundant: the past tense already says it worked.

rules.description: Sentence case in titles, buttons, tabs and labels: only the first word and proper nouns are capitalized; all-caps text is applied with CSS, never typed. The pattern is a heuristic that flags a second capitalized word at the start (Title Case, ALL CAPS).
Buttons are a verb plus an object. Never a bare OK or Send.
A destructive confirmation names the object and the consequence in one sentence. The confirm button names the action; initial focus is on Cancel.

good: Delete 'Northwind Web'? 'Northwind Web' and its 14 environments will be removed. This can't be undone.

rules.description: Toasts are short and in the past tense: what just happened. A toast for a reversible action offers Undo.
An empty state says what happened and what to do next.

good: No orders found. Try another filter or search term.

rules.description: Errors say how to fix the problem. Never just that something is invalid.
No emoji. Icons come from the icon set; unicode glyphs only inside labelled IconButtons.
The ellipsis is only for menu items that open something ('Move to…'). No 'Loading...' or 'Saving...'.
Numbers, codes, amounts and shortcuts use the mono font (Geist Mono): ORD-1048, $1,240.00, ⌘K.
Currency, dates and numbers are formatted with Intl for the active locale (formatCurrency, formatDate, formatNumber). Never hand-build them. Money is an integer in minor units.
Lists, groups, columns and select options are alphabetical (locale-aware, accent-insensitive) by default. Exceptions: tasks (by urgency) and dated records (newest first). Use sortByText.
Status and meaning are always stated in text; color and icons only reinforce them.

good: Badge text 'Failed' in the danger tone
bad: A red dot with no text

rules.description: Built-in strings and ARIA labels live in the message catalog (<Name>.messages.ts), never as literals in component code. Product copy passed through props belongs to the consumer.

destructiveConfirmation.title: Delete {object}?
destructiveConfirmation.body: {Object} and {dependents} will be removed. This can't be undone.
destructiveConfirmation.followUp: Toast with Undo when the action is reversible

reversibleAction.feedback: Toast in the past tense with an Undo action
